meta.name: huggingface-accelerate
meta.description: Simplest distributed training API. 4 lines to add distributed support to any PyTorch script. Unified API for DeepSpeed/FSDP/Megatron/DDP. Automatic device placement, mixed precision (FP16/BF16/FP8). Interactive config, single launch command. HuggingFace ecosystem standard.

copy.tagline: 给任意 PyTorch 脚本添加分布式训练支持
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多GPU或多节点上加速PyTorch模型训练
copy.tagline_en: Add distributed training support to any PyTorch script
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to accelerate PyTorch model training across multiple GPUs or nodes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把普通的 PyTorch 训练脚本改成支持多 GPU、混合精度、DeepSpeed 或 FSDP 的分布式训练脚本，只需加 4 行代码。
howto.when: 当你需要把单 GPU 的 PyTorch 训练扩展到多 GPU、多节点，或者想启用混合精度、DeepSpeed、FSDP 等分布式策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 PyTorch 训练脚本改成支持多 GPU 分布式训练。
给这个训练脚本加上 FP16 混合精度。
帮我配置 DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 并修改训练脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you convert a plain PyTorch training script into a distributed training script supporting multi-GPU, mixed precision, DeepSpeed, or FSDP by adding just 4 lines of code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to scale a single-GPU PyTorch training to multi-GPU, multi-node, or enable mixed precision, DeepSpeed, FSDP, or other distributed strategies.

say_en.text: Convert this PyTorch training script to support multi-GPU distributed training.
say_en.note: Claude will add the 4 Accelerator lines and provide launch commands.

say_en.text: Add FP16 mixed precision to this training script.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the Accelerator initialization and adjust the code.

say_en.text: Configure DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 and modify the training script.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a DeepSpeed config and integrate it into the script.
